spec.title: application-core Phase 5: a String inside an object (J1's O2, checked-claim on the quote family), on the own checker with no JBMC
spec.description: At the revision that commits this job (llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md, Phase 5, after the receiver-with-dependencies piece left J1's O2 part refused on the request's String code). The regression check (equivalence, so also the heap check of a planned claim) now makes a constructor's String argument as a leaf of its construction (harness::is_leaf; a plan's adapted String inside a node), a value of the String adapter of at most the check's bound of code units, never null, and compares a String field by content (harness::FieldKind::String, String.equals), never by identity. Step 2 runs lib/tests/application_core_joint.rs's j1_o2_a_receiver_with_dependencies_and_a_request_with_a_string (acceptance rows J1 and O2): the frozen checked-claim (QuoteService#checked, domain planned: the service with three null dependencies and the request made from a String code of at most 4 code units and an int array of at most 4, allocations bounded at 1, unwind 16), engine native, every build of the quote family, no refusal accepted: after and six defects verified with every observation preserved, each rerun under one proof cache the stored result under the same key; alias-to-copy held to the allocation gate's outcome (unresolved: its code may make 3 objects, more than the frozen bound of 1), a user decision recorded in the brief's Progress; and under a bound of 3, after verified and alias-to-copy refuted (violation) on identity:result==request with its witness run on a JVM. Step 3 runs lib/tests/object_strings.rs (3 tests): four rewrites over Strings inside objects proved, three defects refuted and run on a JVM; the property check, --engine jbmc and plans with a String bounded otherwise, nullable, misnamed or a list inside a node refused by name; an exact rerun reused but not under another bound or after an edit of the constructor taking the String. Each step runs with a jbmc first on PATH that records being called, and the last step fails if it was. Expected process status 0 for every step.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: j1_o2_a_receiver_with_dependencies_and_a_request_with_a_string and the 3 object_strings tests pass, and the last step finds no call of jbmc

steps.name: build the tests and the recording jbmc
steps.run:
cd lib && rm -rf target/strings-shim && mkdir -p target/strings-shim/bin && printf "#!/bin/sh
touch %s/target/strings-shim/jbmc-called
exit 127
" "$PWD" > target/strings-shim/bin/jbmc && chmod +x target/strings-shim/bin/jbmc && cargo test --release --test application_core_joint --test object_strings --no-run

steps.name: J1 (O2): checked-claim with the request's String code
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && PATH="$PWD/target/strings-shim/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --test application_core_joint j1_o2_a_receiver_with_dependencies_and_a_request_with_a_string -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee target/strings-j1-o2.log

steps.name: the String-inside-an-object tests
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && PATH="$PWD/target/strings-shim/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --test object_strings -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tee target/strings-tests.log

steps.name: J2's guard: no check called jbmc
steps.run: cd lib && test ! -e target/strings-shim/jbmc-called && echo "no check called jbmc"
